profile.ja: 五車学園に通う学生対魔忍。氷室家は対魔忍の名家で、彼女も早くから対魔の力に目覚め、学生の身ながら高難易度の任務もこなす実力者として認められている。学園では風紀委員長をやっていて、規律を重んじ、素行は良いがやや堅く融通が利かない性格の持ち主。一流の対魔忍になるために常に鍛錬を怠らず、そのためか風紀を乱す学生や、遊んでいる者、適当にしか修練をしない者に対してはとことん厳しく当たる。
profile.en: Himuro Karen is a student Taimanin attending Gosha Academy. The Himuro family is a renowned Taimanin lineage, and she awakened her anti-demon powers early, earning recognition as a capable operative who can handle high-difficulty missions despite still being a student. At the academy she serves as head of the Moral Committee, valuing discipline and maintaining a spotless record, though her personality is somewhat rigid and inflexible. She never skips training in her quest to become a top-tier Taimanin, and because of that she deals harshly with students who disrupt order, those who fool around, or anyone who trains half-heartedly.

text.ja: 三年の氷室花蓮、風紀委員長よ。サボタージュの監視なんかは管轄外だけど――見つけたらもちろん容赦はしないから、そのつもりでいなさい
text.en: I'm Himuro Karen, a third-year student and head of the Moral Committee. While monitoring sabotage isn't my jurisdiction, I'll show no mercy if I catch you - so, be prepared.

text.ja: ――遅刻はあまりしないようね、結構。でも、服装が少しだらしないわ……襟を正して、裾はしまいなさい。まったく……さ、これでよし
text.en: Don't be late too often, okay? But your outfit's a bit sloppy... fix your collar and tuck in your hem. Honestly... there, that's better.

text.ja: あら――そろそろ授業が始まるわよ？　そっちは図書室しかないのだから、この時間に用事なんてないわよね？　さ、教室に戻りなさい
text.en: Oh, it's almost time for class, isn't it? You don't have any business at this hour, since the only thing around here is the library. Come on, get back to class.

text.ja: 余計なモノの持ち込みは、禁止なのだけど……古い忍術や、忍法の技術書なら――参考書、ということでありかしら……うーん、ありにしておくわ
text.en: Bringing in unnecessary items is prohibited, but... if it's an old ninja technique or a ninja law book, I suppose it could be considered a reference book... hmm, I'll let it slide.

text.ja: こら、学校帰りの買い食いは禁止――だったかしら？　ちょっと校則を確認してみるわ……あ、待ちなさい！　確認する前に逃げないの！
text.en: Wait, wasn't buying snacks on the way home from school prohibited? Let me just check the rules... ah, wait up! Don't try to sneak away before I've checked!

text.ja: あなたは女子のお友達が多いようだけど……ふ、不純なことは、していないでしょうね？　風紀を乱す行為には、厳しい罰則があるんだからね
text.en: You seem to have a lot of female friends... but I hope you're not doing anything improper. There are strict penalties for behavior that disrupts discipline, you know.

text.ja: ほらっ、シャンと背筋を伸ばして！　顔を上げて、胸を張る！　朝の挨拶は、元気よくしなさい！　サボりなんて、絶対に許さないからね！
text.en: Straighten up and stand tall! Look up, chest out! Morning greetings should be energetic! I won't tolerate any slacking off, got it?

text.ja: ふらふらしないの！　あなたはね、もう少しシャンとしてればもっと……な、何でもないわよ、早く行きなさい！
text.en: Don't slouch! If you just stood up a bit straighter, you'd... never mind, just hurry up and go!

text.ja: こ、こら、だめ……んっ……私は、風紀委員長、なんだからっ……私自ら、風紀を乱すわけには……んっ、あっ……
text.en: H-hey, no... I'm the head of the Moral Committee, after all... I couldn't possibly be the one to disrupt discipline... hmmm, ahh...

text.ja: はぁ、あぁ、あうぅ……ふ、風紀委員長なのに……こんな所で、こんな格好しちゃうなんて……はぁ、はぁ……覚えて、おきなさいよ……
text.en: Haa, ahh, auu... as the head of the Moral Committee... to be seen like this, in a place like this... haa, haa... remember this, and don't forget.

text.ja: はい、これ。何って、避妊具よ、ひ・に・ん・ぐ！　お互い学生なんだからちゃんとしておかないと。多い？　た、足りなかったら困るでしょ！
text.en: Yes, here. It's a contraceptive, a condom! We're both students, so we need to be responsible. Is it enough? If we run out, it'd be a problem, wouldn't it?
